fixes.explanation: Good thinking, friend, but the verse says law. Josiah did this to carry out “…the words of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had found in the house of the LORD.” And look at the list he cleared out: mediums and spiritists, household gods and idols, and all the abominations in Judah and Jerusalem. That's a big cleanup, and this verse ties all of it to the law in that book.
